en.title: Blue Wind Sky Runner and Beyond the Silver Cherry Blossom
en.premise: In a world above the clouds, a boy named Kai dreams of becoming the fastest airship pilot. One day he meets Liria, a mysterious navigator cursed with a spell that forbids her from lying. Together they set out for the legendary island of Silver Cherry Blossom, said to hold the power to reboot the world. Chasing the imperial army, they cut through the wind, forging a bond and a quest for freedom. Their grand adventure begins.

zh.title: 碧風的天空跑者與銀桜彼岸
zh.premise: 在雲端之上，少年凯梦想成为最快的飞艇驾驶员。一天，他遇见了被诅咒不能说谎的神秘航海士莉莉亚。两人踏上寻找传说中的“银桜岛”，据说那里拥有重启世界的力量。面对帝国军的追击，他们在风中疾驰，结下深厚的羁绊，追寻自由与冒险。大冒险即将展开。
